parts.name: estop
parts.desc: OMRON A22E-M-02 emergency stop (v12.1 model: switch block behind the panel, from the data sheet's A22E-M drawing), in estop_bracket's panel leg, head forward at hand height.
parts.model_source: re-made from OMRON A22E data sheet p.41 (A22E-M): head 40 / 6.5 / 32 in front; switch block 34 high, 41.2 long, ending 54.7 behind the panel's front (starts 13.5 behind it); barrel, bushing, ring nut and block width not dimensioned (estimates)

parts.name: estop_bracket
parts.desc: v12.1: e-stop bracket, 5052-H32 .125 in bent once (SendCutSend). An L round the front-left post's front-right corner: the panel leg on the post's front face carries the OMRON A22E-M-02 in its 22.3 mm cut-out, 30 mm left of the post; two M5 in the post's front slot and two in its right-hand slot (two columns, two faces).

findings.message: estop_bracket: 2 hole(s) closer than 6.34946 mm (2 x thickness) to where a bend's radius starts (nearest 4.07 mm, a 5.5 mm hole at [-160.0, -197.76, 313.0]): the hole stretches into an oval when the bend is formed.
findings.hint: Move the hole at least 6.34946 mm from the bend, add a relief slot along the bend, or drill it after bending.

findings.message: estop_bracket: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_edge_d_ratio: hole edge to part edge 12.8 mm (1 of 5), limit >= 22.3 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "we generally recommend keeping your holes at least 1X their diameter from an edge and slots at least 1.5X their width away from edges or other cut features.").

estop_bracket: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.bend.die_width.al5052.3.175mm: hole or cut-out to bend 7.67 mm (2 of 5), limit >= 8 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "Bending specifications per material (bending calculator), 5052 Aluminum .125″: Die Width .630″. Bend deformation guideline: make sure your cut features are at l").

estop_bracket: 4 outside corner(s) of the cut profile are dead sharp (no radius). A sheet part with needle corners cuts hands and cables and chips its paint; a corner radius costs nothing in laser or waterjet cutting.
findings.hint: Round every outside corner to at least 0.5 mm (1 to 3 mm on corners a hand meets).

findings.message: estop_bracket (al5052, 3.175 mm, bent): assigned SendCutSend: passes, 2 recommendation(s) not met. Passes the published rules of: Fictiv, Hubs (Protolabs Network), OSH Cut, Protolabs, SendCutSend, Xometry.
